text: Ben Warner said Gartner described the category as a solution for simulating synthetic human populations and predicting human attitudes and behaviours.
Electric Twin sits on top of News UK's first-party data infrastructure and generates synthetic versions of the audience, according to the user's read of the Warner post and Times deal.

The same surface logic appears across No. 10 population-level policy modeling, News UK synthetic audience substitution, and Gartner category formation: modeled population replaces consulted population.
The UK government terms of reference published on 26 July 2024 identify Matt Clifford as the person leading development of the AI Opportunities Action Plan.
On 13 January 2025, the official government response said all fifty recommendations of the Matt Clifford-led AI Opportunities Action Plan would be taken forward.

Electric Twin written resolutions dated 12 September 2025 authorized allotments or subscription/conversion rights up to aggregate nominal £1.197496, adopted replacement articles, disapplied pre-emption rights for allotments under that authority, and authorized redesignation of up to 741,051 ordinary shares as Seed 1 Preferred.

Electric Twin articles adopted 12 September 2025 cap the board at five absent an ordinary resolution with Founder Majority consent, give Founder Majority the right to appoint a board majority, give Atomico a conditional right to appoint one director and one non-voting observer while it and permitted transferees hold equity, and give LocalGlobe a conditional right to appoint one director while it and permitted transferees hold equity.

The adopted articles require an initial board quorum of three including at least one Investor Director if appointed, give Major Investors pro rata first-offer rights over New Securities unless Investor Majority Consent permits otherwise, define the Seed 2 Preferred Preference Amount as £9.267 per share, and place Seed Preferred holders ahead of Ordinary holders in the liquidation and exit waterfall for the greater of the applicable preference amount and the as-converted Ordinary distribution.
Electric Twin form SH08 records the redesignation on 16 September 2025 of 741,051 Ordinary shares of £0.000001 each as 741,051 Seed 1 Preferred shares of £0.000001 each.

Electric Twin SH01 returns record 604,294 Seed 2 Preferred shares allotted on 16 September, 86,327 on 17 September, and 48,559 on 26 September 2025, each at nominal value £0.000001, amount paid £9.267, amount unpaid £0, and cash-only status; the final filed statement of capital contains 739,180 Seed 2 Preferred shares.

The three Electric Twin SH01 returns identify the issuer, dates, class, quantities, nominal value, amount paid and unpaid, cash status, and resulting capital, but do not identify the recipients of the allotted shares.
